methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series C → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.7x) to $450M total raised proxy.

private.name: Meter
private.rationale: Same sector (Housing & Construction), same stage (Series C)

data.narrative:
ICON is a Series C-stage housing and construction company that has raised over $450M to date. The valuation analysis is constrained by a limited comparable universe: no public peers and only one identified private comparable (Meter) in the frontier construction technology sector.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach, using the $450M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C progression. This method yields an implied valuation of $765M. Given the single-method constraint and inherent uncertainty in stage-based multipliers, the analysis supports a range of $650M to $880M, with $765M as the central estimate.

Key uncertainties materially affect reliability of this valuation. The scarcity of comparable data points—particularly the absence of public market benchmarks and limited private peer data—prevents cross-validation through revenue multiples, gross margin analysis, or unit economics. The applicability of a 1.7x multiplier to ICON specifically remains unvalidated without visibility into growth rates, burn dynamics, or pathway to profitability relative to stage peers. Resolution of the current undisclosed valuation status and granular revenue or customer concentration metrics would strengthen conviction in this range.
